newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Cairo Precision Industries to issue shares.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Cairo Precision Industries to issue shares.

text.p: Egypt's Cairo Precision Industries, an affiliate of Olympic Electric group of companies, will issue 300,000 new shares worth some 25 million pounds ($7.35 million) to finance production activities, a group official said on Sunday.

The share offer, to be announced in the next few days, will cut the parent company's stake in the manufacturer of heaters from 80 to about 60 percent, Ahmed Mohamadin, general manager for securities and finance at the holding company, told Reuters.
Financial institutions and mutual funds hold the remaining 20 percent of 1.5 million shares in the firm, Mohamadin said.
The minimum application accepted will be for 25 shares.
The shares are rarely traded on the Egyptian bourse.
Cairo Precision was set up in 1991, but the parent company Olympic Electric has been producing heaters for 33 years.
"The new funds will help the firm develop its production and produce the first heater to be operated by gas or electricity," Mohamadin said.
He said net sales were 53.849 million pounds and profits 14.755 million in 1995. The firm estimates sales to rise to 59.968 million pounds this year and profits to 15.931 million.
